summary_en: ARE Holdings authorized the acquisition of up to 2.2 million shares (2.55% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥7.5 billion via ToSTNeT-3 on November 5, 2026, to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder value.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
ARE Holdings resolved on November 4, 2026, to acquire up to 2.2 million shares of its common stock for a maximum of ¥7.5 billion. The acquisition represents 2.55% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The company will execute the purchase via ToSTNeT-3, Tokyo Stock Exchange's off-auction trading facility, on November 5, 2026.

The stated purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder value through flexible capital policy execution. As of October 31, 2026, the company held 860,324 treasury shares, including 473,050 shares held by an ESOP trust for stock grants and 262,300 shares held by an executive compensation BIP trust account.
